The scorecard

Five findings.
Five fixes.

What the audit found on ocalaflacrepair.com — and what the agenticrx version does about each one.

🔴 Costing you jobs

'24/7' with no online booking

Every CTA is "Call Now: (352) 644-7945." At 2 AM with a dead AC, there's no form, no chat, no booking — just a number and hope someone picks up.

The agenticrx fix: Ava answers in 8 seconds, captures the job, and texts a confirmation — overnight, weekends, holidays.
🔴 Costing you jobs

No text or chat option

A big share of homeowners would rather text than call — the site offers neither. The 24/7 promise only works for people willing to dial.

The agenticrx fix: Click-to-text on every page — the conversation starts in SMS and the job books there.
🔴 Costing you trust

No reviews anywhere on the site

Zero customer proof on a site asking for trust at 2 AM. Emergency visitors choose the company that looks proven.

The agenticrx fix: A live review feed on the homepage, auto-replies to every review, and review requests texted after every job.
🟡 Leaving money on the table

Service-area clarity is vague

"Ocala and surrounding areas" — visitors in Belleview or Dunnellon can't tell if they're covered without calling to ask.

The agenticrx fix: A service-area checker in chat — type your ZIP, get an instant yes and a booking link.
🟡 Leaving money on the table

One page, one action

The entire conversion strategy is a single phone number repeated. If the line's busy — and at 2 AM during a heat wave it will be — the job is gone.

The agenticrx fix: AI answers every call and every chat simultaneously — no busy signals, ever.
